title: Community Health Worker: Children and Families
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Community Health Worker: Children and Families Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Apply culturally competent care by recognizing the health needs of diverse populations and utilizing strategies that promote equity and inclusion in health and social service settings.

Demonstrate effective communication and interpersonal skills by building trust, providing social support, and educating individuals and communities in ways that enhance health literacy and self-sufﬁciency.
Coordinate and manage care through effective system navigation, referrals, and follow-up to ensure access to needed health and social services.
Advocate for health equity by supporting community-led efforts to address social determinants of health and participating in policy advocacy initiatives.
Provide basic health services and assessments that support community health needs, including screenings, ﬁrst aid, and environmental assessments.
Promote personal and community wellness through outreach, education, and empowerment strategies that address chronic disease prevention and health promotion.
